scope: Aircraft currently in operational use; exclude historical display aircraft, retired types and prototypes. Remaining candidates require source verification.

excluded.viggen: Retired operational type; historic/display flying does not qualify.
excluded.draken: Retired operational type; historic/display flying does not qualify.
excluded.f104: Retired operational type; historic/display flying does not qualify.
excluded.f117: Retired from operational combat service; limited test flying does not qualify.
excluded.su37: Technology demonstrator, not an operational production type.
excluded.b21: Development/test aircraft; do not include without evidence of operational service.
excluded.v280: Technology demonstrator; distinct from future production variants.
excluded.an225: Sole completed aircraft destroyed; not currently operational.
excluded.spitfire: Historical/display aircraft outside the selected scope.
excluded.p51: Historical/display aircraft outside the selected scope.
excluded.bf109: Historical/display aircraft outside the selected scope.
excluded.po2: Historical/display aircraft outside the selected scope.
